title: Expression Interpolation Keyframe Stepper
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Interpret how expression interpolation computes intermediate face-state parameter values between two keyframes by stepping through individual frames with concrete numbers, and exemplify how an easing curve changes those values compared to plain linear interpolation.

learningObjectives: Interpret how expression interpolation computes intermediate face-state parameter values between two keyframes by stepping through individual frames with concrete numbers, and exemplify how an easing curve changes those values compared to plain linear interpolation.
